commitments.text: Westroc must cause the Development to be designed, located, constructed and operated in accordance with the application that is comprised of: Application for a Mine Development Certificate for the Elkhorn Quarry Extension, Westroc Industries Ltd., Windermere Mining Operations, May, 1995; Letter from R. Jarrett, Mine Manager, Windermere Mining Operations, to A. Whale, Chair, Kootenay Mine Development Review Committee, June 2, 1995; Letter from R. Jarrett to A. Whale, June 21, 1995.
